tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'chi med grub pa'i khrid yig gsal bar ma thon pa'i man ngag 'jug tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag mchog /dpal ldan 'chi med grub pa la/ /dkyus kyi rim pa bzhin du bshad/ /gnad kyi zhal bzhes 'dir bstan te/ /lte ba'i aṃ yig 'bar ba'i me/ /lus rnams thams cad khyab pa las/ /gtun brdung byas pas me lce rnams/ /thur du bab par bsgom par bya/ /me lce gsang ba'i sgo ru thon/ /lte gsang gnyis la sems gtod cing*/ /mig ni sna rtser blta bar bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i man ngag yin/ /snying gar hūṃ yig bsgom pa las/ /yar 'then pa dang mar byon pa/ /gnyis ka'i dus su me dang rlung*/ /'thab nas snying khar thim par bsgom/ /de yi bar skabs yang yang du/ kha sbyor dang nas sprugs pa dang*/ /ha sprugs byed pa gnad du che/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'i man ngag yin/ /rkang mthil gnyis dang bshang sgo gnyis/ /'od zer dkar dang ljang khu dang*/ /lus nang gang zhing spyi bo dang*/ /mgrin pa'i gnas su 'khyil nas kyang*/ /res 'ga' gnas der yal bar bsgoms/ /res 'ga' ba spu kun las spro/ /res 'ga' spyi bo'i gtsug nas spro/ /dam tshig phyag rgya'i man ngag yin/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo me 'od bsgom/ /rlung gis yang yang phyir bsal bas/ /me 'od sna nag rgyang ring 'gro/ /res 'ga' mgrin par sgor zhing sprug /bum pa can gyi gegs sel dang*/ /bogs 'don dag kyang gal che ste/ skabs su skabs su rgyun du min/ /phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag yin/ /nang nas 'od 'byung sna nas thon/ /phyi nang thams cad gsal bar bsgom/ /skyon rnams phyir bsal 'dod rigs gsal/ /rdul mtha' can la dgos pa yin/ /lte 'og sor bzhi me thab bsgom/ /rlung rnams de'i ngang nang du thim/ /thabs lte g.yas g.yon yang yang 'khor/ /gang ba can la dgos pa yin/ /a wa dhu ti stong pa gcig /bsam nas yar lta mar ltar byed/ /bum pa can gyi sngon 'gro yin/

/ 'dzam gling 'dzin du dgos pa yin/ /rig pa nang nas phyir spros te/ /nam mkha' dag la yal bar bsgom/ /res 'ga' phyi nas nang du bsdu/ /sgra gcan gdams ngag yin zhes gsungs/ /phyag rgya gsum po'i rnal 'byor la/ /sgra gcan grogs su med thabs med/ /aṃ grol drag po'i grong khyer 'jigs/ /be tas 'phrog byed grong khyer brtsom/ /nan dha ching pa'i grong khyer bshigs/ /phyag rgya gsum gyi mtha' bskor nas/ /bshig par byed mkhan sgra gcan yin/ / gnad 'di rnams ni lo gsum du/ /sgom na rlung las rnam par rgyal/ /rtsa rnams dag kyang mnyen bcug 'gyur/ /thig le dwangs shing rang dbang 'dus/ /rig 'dzin mngon shes dpag med 'char/ /grol lam rang lus thabs ldan gyis/ / ye shes gong nas gong spel ba/ /gdams ngag 'di yi gzhung shing yin/ /gzhan lus shes rab yan lag bcing*/ /lam gzhan dag dang ma 'dres par/ /lugs 'di nyid kyi srol bzung nas/ /rang gi lus kyi phyag rgya dang*/ /lhan cig bsgrub pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gong du bshad pa'i man ngag rnams/ /yun ring bsgom pa'i dus su ni/ /ched du bsgom pa ma yin par/ /gsal stong bde nyams ldan pa la/ /chu tshod re tsam gnas pa yod/ /ting 'dzin de ltar ma skyes na'o/ /ban+dha dang ni sgra gcan la/ /rlung dmar drag po btab pa'i tshe/ /phyi ru nang du 'dren pa yod/ /de yang nges pa'i rtags gcig yin/ /spyir ni ting 'dzin ma thob na/ / rlung gi rgyu ba skyod thub kyang*/ /rnam dag las lam min zhes gsungs/ /de phyir phyi nang 'dzom pa gces/ /rtag snang mkhyen bsgrod sgra yang 'byung*/ /ban+dha 'grems pa'ang rang sgra yod/ /res 'ga' gtsug tu kyer bar 'byung*/ /de la ha srang yo ga zhes/ /dus skabs gzhan du log byung na/ /karma mu dra'i dus yin no/ /snun pa las kyi phyag rgya dgag /de rjes sgra gcan rlung gi dkyil/ /'ching na dam tshig phyag rgyas 'dren/ /sgra gcan gyis kyang gnas su skyel/

/bsad pa chos kyi phyag rgyas dgrol/ /sgra gcan lag pa gnyis bcing ba/ /rtsa dmigs 'debs pa man ngag yin/ /'debs gsum rlung dang tshig ma dbab/ /de rjes phyag rgya chen po yin/ /ye shes chen po'i gnas su skyel/ /mgrin pa nas ni rlung g.yang bas/ /rlung gi dug kyang sel bar byed/ /de dus bum can bzung nas ni/ /yun ring dus su ting 'dzin skyong*/ /rlung dang thig le sems gsum 'dres/ /yang dag gnas lugs don ma rtogs/ /rel tshags gnas them sbyor ba dang*/ /'gyur bzhi rnam rol bsgrod pa'i mtha'/ /gling bzhi gcud la 'bor ba sogs/ /spyi 'gros yin pas blangs kyang chog /mtshan ldan bla mas de skad gsungs/ /'on kyang gong du bshad pa ltar/ /'chug med gnad don nyams blangs na/ /'di nyid kho na 'phral du zab/ /phugs su yon tan skye phul che/ /zhes 'chi med grub pa'i khrid yig gsal bar ma thon pa'i man ngag 'jug tshul ma 'ga' zhig /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas tshigs bcad ldebs pa'o// //bkra shis/ maṅgalaṃ/ dge'o/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 308 -- PAGE 309 -- PAGE 306 -
